_description.summary: Combat and projectiles: explosions and fireballs, magic missiles and projectile conjures (egg, spit, snowball), lesser sentinel deployment and lookup, sentinel banishing, damage triggers, Wisp embark and disembark, Close Transmit.
use_cases: Dealing damage or creating explosions and fireballs
Reacting to the caster taking damage (triggers)

explode.d: Remove a number and vector from the stack, then create an explosion at the given location with the given power.

explode/fire.d: Remove a number and vector from the stack, then create a fiery explosion at the given location with the given power.

sentinel/destroy.d: Banish my sentinel, and remove it from the world. Costs a negligible amount of media.

link/comm/close_transmit.d: When drawn after Open Transmit I stop transmitting drawn patterns. If either Open Transmit or Close Transmit are executed by an intermediary caster such as a wisp, they will mishap.

magic_missile.d: Conjures a small silver of amethyst that always deals a full heart of damage and forces the target backwards. Costs about one Amethyst Dust.

egg.d: Conjures an egg. May be fertile. Costs about two Amethyst Dust.

llama_spit.d: Conjures a sticky low-damaging projectile. Costs about a fourth of one Amethyst Dust.

snowball.d: Conjures a harmless snowball. Costs about half of an Amethyst Dust.

set_lesser_sentinels.d: Dismisses any existing Lesser Sentinels and deploys a Lesser Sentinel at every position in the list.

get_lesser_sentinels.d: Returns a list of vectors corresponding to the positions of all my Lesser Sentinels.

horrible.d: Judging by the pattern signature, I can only imagine that it summons something.

make_damage_trigger.d: Creates a trigger that activates whenever I take damage. To prevent a lethal chain-reaction, does not activate if the damage was caused by overcasting.

make_damage_type_trigger.d: Creates a trigger that activates whenever I take damage, but only if the damage was of a specific type. The trigger will be attuned to whatever type of damage I last received.
